title: FableCut – A browser video editor AI agents can drive (zero deps)
claim: Zero-dependency browser video editor built to be driven by AI agents — a JSON timeline as the source of truth, MCP + REST APIs, live-reloading UI.
why_good: Every “AI video agent” demo still bottoms out in a human-operated editor; FableCut inverts that by making the timeline a machine-writable format first and a UI second. Agent-operable creative tools are an empty shelf right now.
value: The editing backend for AI video products — usage-priced API for agent-driven edits, with the open editor as distribution. Owning the timeline format agents speak is a standards play.
risk: Video editing is a graveyard of feature-rich incumbents; if CapCut or Descript expose agent APIs, a zero-dep editor's headroom shrinks to a niche. 557 stars is interest, not yet usage.

zh.claim: 零依赖、跑在浏览器里的视频剪辑器，为 AI 代理操控而生 — JSON 时间线为唯一事实源，MCP + REST 接口，界面实时热更新。
zh.why_good: 所有“AI 视频代理”的演示最后都卡在需要人操作的剪辑器上；FableCut 反过来：时间线先是机器可写的格式，其次才是界面。“代理可操作的创作工具”眼下还是空货架。
zh.value: 做 AI 视频产品的剪辑后端 — 按用量计费的代理剪辑 API，开源编辑器充当获客渠道。占住“代理通用的时间线格式”是一场标准之争。
zh.risk: 视频剪辑是功能齐全的巨头坟场；若 CapCut/Descript 开放代理接口，零依赖编辑器的空间会缩到利基。557 星是关注，还不是使用。
